items.title: Mastercard Is “One of the Greatest Businesses in the World,” Says Bill Ackman. Do the Estimates Agree?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBill Ackman said on CNBC on Tuesday that he picked up Visa (V:NYSE) and Mastercard (MA:NYSE) in the low 20s times earnings, and he called them a royalty on consumer spending. Analysts expect Mastercard’s normalized EPS to grow about 16% a year from 2026 to 2028, faster than the roughly 14% a year they expect from Visa.

items.title: Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) Targets Saudi AI And Cross Border Payments
items.summary: Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) has partnered Tencent Cloud with Saudi-based OmniOps to support enterprise AI development in the kingdom. The group has also agreed new collaborations with Mastercard and UnionPay to expand cross-border remittances and payment options for users. These payment tie ups are intended to support Tencent's international remittance channels and its broader digital ecosystem outside mainland China.
